dataset: KAMPS public-record abduction / enforced-disappearance / related police-killing incidents, Kenya 2024-2026
methodology: Curated from sources fetched directly with curl (HTTP 200 verified at retrieval time) or from references extracted from Wikipedia wikitext fetched via the MediaWiki API. No fabricated entries; every entry has at least one real sourceUrl. datePrecision 'month' used when only the month is documented.

sources.name: AP News (ref via Wikipedia; blocks bots)

context_statistics.statistic: KNCHR: 32 enforced/involuntary disappearances and 627 arrests during Finance Bill protests (18 Jun - 1 Jul 2024); 39 killed, 361 injured
KNCHR: 82 cases of abductions and enforced disappearances since June 2024, 29 unaccounted for (as of Jan 2025)
HRW: 44% increase in abductions Sep 2023-Aug 2024 (52 vs 36 cases)
HRW World Report 2026 (via Al Jazeera): 26 people linked to 2024 protests and 15 linked to 2025 demonstrations remain missing
IPOA: of 62 killed in 2024 anti-finance-bill protests, only 3 cases have reached court (June 2026 statement)

incidents.notes: 29-year-old shot ~7pm during anti-Finance Bill protest; pronounced dead at Bliss Hospital. One of the first protest fatalities.
24-year-old arrested by police at Imenti House on 25 June 2024 during OccupyParliament protests; still missing two years on per family.
23-year-old taken by police from a house shared with cousins days after posting video of protesters inside Parliament; later found dead.

incidents.sourceName: AP News (reference verified via Wikipedia: Kenya Finance Bill protests)
incidents.notes: Influencer who hosted Ruto's X forum; Ruto apologized for Otero's abduction by police during the protests (AP, 7 July 2024). AP article URL in Wikipedia ref: https://apnews.com/article/kenya-protests-finance-bill-william-ruto-65965d6b7f9b4a713be6ee6a47d382aa (AP blocks automated fetch: HTTP 403).
Son of then-Public Service CS Justin Muturi; abducted during 2024 antigovernment protests; CS said President Ruto called NIS after which he was released. Exact date not stated in source (mid-2024).
Veteran journalist bundled into a car at Karen Police Station by unidentified men; released same day; DCI called it mistaken identity.
Abducted with brother Aslam by armed plainclothes group; held ~5 days, blindfolded, tortured; abandoned at Gachie, Kiambu.
36-year-old cybercafe operator, antigovernment protester; abducted with brother Jamil; released at Gachie.
Activist, 'one of three individuals abducted in Kitengela in August' (with the Longton brothers); later freed; abducted again in Uganda in Oct 2025 (see 2025-10-01 entry).

incidents.location: Nairobi (Enterprise Road, Industrial Area); Wajir County
incidents.notes: Wajir Dela/Della Anole MCA abducted 13 Sep 2024; body found in Lake Yahud in Oct initially feared to be his but DNA ruled it out; reunited with family ~8 Mar 2025. Also: https://capitalfm.africa/tension-in-wajir-as-body-of-missing-mca-identified/
British national of Turkish origin abducted by ~8 masked men; released after 8 hours when he showed his British passport.

incidents.person: Huseyin Yesilsu and three Turkish refugees
incidents.notes: Turkish citizens abducted in Nairobi 18 Oct 2024; Kenyan foreign ministry later said four missing Turkish refugees (Gulen movement) were repatriated at Ankara's request; UN 'deeply concerned' (23 Oct 2024).
'Mlolongo 3': arrested by men believed to be police 16 Dec 2024; body found in Ruai river, identified at City Mortuary 30 Jan 2025 after IG Kanja & DCI Amin told court he was not in police custody.
'Mlolongo 3': body positively identified by family at City Mortuary 30 Jan 2025.
Third of the 'Mlolongo 3'; still missing as of March 2025 report. Also Capital FM: https://capitalfm.africa/one-of-the-mlolongo-3-abductees-found-dead-in-ruai/
College student abducted in Embu in December 2024 among six youths critical of the president; freed 6 Jan 2025, returned frail. Exact abduction day not stated; freed day verified.
Content creator picked up in Ngong; freed 6 Jan 2025, found over 400km away in Kitale. Exact abduction day not stated.
Taken from Uthiru; freed 6 Jan 2025, abandoned in Nairobi CBD. Exact abduction day not stated.
Silhouettes cartoonist (Ruto caricatures) abducted 24 Dec 2024 after meeting Senator Okiya Omtatah; found alive 6 Jan 2025, abandoned at Luanda, Vihiga County ~3am.
Kibet Bull's brother; taken from Kikuyu on Christmas Day; freed 6 Jan 2025, dropped in Machakos.
Tanzanian journalist/activist abducted in Nairobi in January 2025 after leaving a salon; later released. Exact day not stated in source.
MP abducted by unknown men after church service Sunday 25 May 2025; found badly beaten on a Ruiru coffee farm Monday morning, hospitalized at Karen Hospital.

Teacher/blogger arrested 6-7 June 2025 for alleged defamation of Deputy IG of Police; died in custody night of 7-8 June; autopsy (10 June) found death from physical assault. His death sparked June 2025 protests. Wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Death_of_Albert_Ojwang

Abducted with Nicholas Oyoo by 'armed operatives' at a Kireka petrol station after attending Bobi Wine's rally; freed and repatriated ~8 Nov 2025 after Museveni announced their detention (Wikipedia: 2025 in Kenya, AP ref).
Free Kenya Movement activist abducted with Bob Njagi; released ~8 Nov 2025.

Six people who went missing during 25 June 2026 anniversary protests (of 7 reported missing) found 27 June, allegedly tortured, dumped on Lang'ata Road and near Talanta Stadium; confirmed by KHRC and Haki Africa. Also: https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/6/27/kenya-rights-groups-say-protesters-found-dumped-tortured-after-arrests

Mathare social justice activist went missing 25 June 2026 during Gen Z anniversary commemorations; found 29 June in critical condition, dumped at Kenyatta National Hospital (Social Justice Centres Working Group). Also: https://citizen.digital/article/four-activists-missing-in-mathare-as-families-rights-groups-issue-tuesday-protest-warning-n385396

Families and rights groups reported four activists missing in Mathare (Lichuma + three others) amid a 'surge of enforced disappearances' targeting Mathare activists; 24-hour ultimatum issued 28 June 2026.

incidents.person: Unnamed protester killed during anti-abduction protest
incidents.notes: One person killed (three shot) as police opened fire at protests demanding release of abducted protesters; Reuters also reported (via Wikipedia: Kenya Finance Bill protests).

coverage_notes: Entries limited to publicly reported, individually identifiable incidents with at least one verifiable source (fetched or Wikipedia-reference-verified). Aggregate statistics (e.g., HRW/KNCHR totals) are stored separately in context_statistics. AP News returns 403 to automated fetches; the one AP-sourced entry (Osama Otero) is kept because its reference was extracted from the fetched Wikipedia wikitext. Paywalled Nation Africa articles were not used as primary sourceUrls. Two incidents (Turkish citizens; Ugandan activists) occurred partly outside Kenya but are directly part of Kenya's abduction pattern.
